title: Role → SKOS concept (swimlane glossary)
description: How scripts/glossary-export.ts writes one declared role as a skos:Concept in the swimlane glossary. Bean k74z: the hand-written lines this replaced are inventoried in docs/proposals/vocabulary-mappings-2026-10-02.md, rows 1-6. The role's NAME (title and id, rows 1 and 5) is not here: since bean lodp (finding D3) it comes from the shared table role-naming, which kg-export applies too, so the two generators cannot name one role node two ways. The role's IRI and @type stay in code; they are identity, not mapping.

target.comment: Prepared in code: the names the role's lanes are drawn with, merged with the role's otherNames, minus its title, deduplicated and sorted.
Prepared in code: the role's formerNames, deduplicated and sorted. The ledger's formerLabels are merged in afterwards by the rename pass.
Written only when true: a lane tasks act ON is not a persona, and a reader must be told so.
